function.name: set_ac_state
function.description: Set the state of the air conditioner by adjusting the temperature, mode, fan speed, and fan position to achieve the desired comfort level. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

temperature.description: Desired temperature setting for the air conditioner in degrees Celsius.

fan_speed.description: Fan speed level from 1 to 5, where 1 is the lowest speed and 5 is the highest.

fan_position.description: Fan position level from 1 to 5, where 1 is the lowest and 5 is the highest.

function.name: get_ac_state
function.description: Fetch the current operational state of the air conditioner, including mode, temperature settings, and power status. If 'unit_id' is not provided, the default air conditioner unit will be queried. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

unit_id.description: The unique identifier of the air conditioner unit. If omitted, the system will fetch the state of the default AC unit.

include_diagnostics.description: Whether to include diagnostic information in the response.

I’m here to assist you across a wide range of topics! Here’s a quick rundown:

| Category | What I Can Do |
|----------|---------------|
| **Information & Research** | Provide explanations on science, history, technology, culture, etc., or summarize articles and reports. |
| **Learning Support** | Help study concepts, solve math problems, explain programming logic, offer practice questions, and give feedback on essays. |
| **Writing Assistance** | Draft emails, letters, resumes, cover letters, creative stories, poems, blog posts, academic papers—plus editing and style suggestions. |
| **Technical Guidance** | Offer code snippets (Python, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, SQL), debug errors, walk through algorithms, explain data structures, and discuss best practices. |
| **Creative Brainstorming** | Generate ideas for projects, marketing campaigns, product names, event themes, recipes, travel itineraries, and more. |
| **Daily Life Tips** | Give advice on cooking, fitness routines, time management, budgeting, organization hacks, and self‑care strategies. |
| **Entertainment Recommendations** | Suggest books, movies, TV shows, music playlists tailored to your tastes. |
| **Language Learning** | Translate phrases, correct grammar, provide vocabulary lists, simulate conversations, and explain idioms. |
| **Health & Wellness Basics** | Share general wellness tips, nutrition facts, exercise guidance, mental health resources—but remember this isn’t medical advice; consult professionals when needed. |

If you have something specific in mind—or if you'd like me to demonstrate one of these abilities—just let me know!
